capabilities: Scan the vault and remove emojis from existing filenames via a command or settings
Automatically strip emojis from filenames when new files are created
Automatically strip emojis when a file is renamed
Generate a random fallback name for files whose names would become empty after removal
extras: The author notes this is their first Obsidian plugin, says it likely has bugs, and advises making backups before use; an auto-removal setting and the fallback-name behavior are still on the roadmap for improvement.
problem: Content imported from services like Readwise often has emojis in filenames, which causes sync problems with services such as Dropbox.

relations.evidence: imports notes from other apps (like Readwise)
this can be an issues for other services, mainly, Dropbox

summary: File renaming plugin that strips emojis from note filenames, manually across the vault or automatically on create and rename.
